email_templates.ai_hint: The assistant proposes a text; you decide whether to use it. It never saves anything on its own.
email_templates.ai_instruction_hint: For example: delivery notice, formal tone.
email_templates.ai_invalid: The suggestion uses placeholders that do not exist. Review it before using it.
email_templates.base_readonly: Base templates belong to TMWE: you can view and duplicate them, but not edit them.
email_templates.code_hint: Placeholders such as !#DEST#! are replaced with real data when sending. Copy them exactly, do not translate them.
email_templates.delete_confirm: Delete template {tipo} ({lingua})? Emails of that type will fall back to the base template.
email_templates.descriz_hint: To recognise it in the list.
email_templates.help_hint: These are the values you can insert in this template. Click Insert to append one.
email_templates.mittente_hint: Leave empty to use the partner sender.
email_templates.owner_readonly_hint: A template does not change owner.
email_templates.owner_select_hint: Leave empty to create a base template, used by partners without their own.
email_templates.subtitle: Wording of the emails the system sends to customers and carriers.
email_templates.tipo_hint: Identifies the kind of notice. Cannot be changed later.
email_templates.visual_hint: Write formatted text as in a word processor. Use the Placeholders button to insert data filled in on sending.
